# Security Scan at Scale — Copilot Instructions

A Node.js/TypeScript CLI that orchestrates security scans across many GitHub repositories and LLM models in parallel using the GitHub Copilot SDK. See [README.md](../README.md) for full architecture and setup.

## Key Commands

```bash
npm run dev -- -c config.yml        # Run with TUI (development, no build needed)
npm run dev -- -c config.yml --no-ui # Run without TUI (plain log output)
npm run build                        # Compile TypeScript → dist/
npm start                            # Run compiled output
```

Required env var: `GITHUB_TOKEN` (for private repo access and Copilot SDK auth). Use a `.env` file or export.

## Architecture

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `src/cli.ts` | Entry point, CLI flags, mounts Ink TUI or plain mode |
| `src/config.ts` | Zod schema + YAML loader; throws `ConfigError` on invalid input |
| `src/orchestrator.ts` | `p-queue` fan-out over all `(repo, model)` pairs; emits events to TUI |
| `src/scanner.ts` | Per-scan pipeline: clone → apm install → run commands |
| `src/copilot.ts` | Copilot SDK session wrapper with stdout suppression |
| `src/results.ts` | Collects `.sss/` artifacts → `results/{owner-repo}/{model}/` |
| `src/ui/Dashboard.tsx` | Ink-based TUI dashboard driven by orchestrator `EventEmitter` |

## Critical Conventions

**ESM imports require `.js` extensions.** `moduleResolution: NodeNext` — always use `./foo.js` even when the source file is `foo.ts`.

**No build step for development.** `tsx` executes TypeScript directly. Only run `npm run build` for production.

**stdout/stderr suppression pattern.** `copilot.ts` uses a reference-counted `suppressStdout()`/`restoreStdout()` to prevent the Copilot SDK from corrupting Ink's cursor tracking. Do not write directly to `process.stdout` from concurrent async code while the TUI is active.

**Scan ID format.** `computeScanId(repoUrl, model)` (in `scanner.ts`) produces `{url-slug}__{model-slug}`. Workspace and legacy log paths are keyed by this ID; final results land in `results/{owner-repo}/{model}/`.

**Config is Zod-validated.** Add new config fields to `ConfigSchema` in `config.ts`; defaults belong in the schema, not in consumers.

**APM provisioning.** If `apmPack` is set in config, `apm install` is run inside each cloned workspace before Copilot sessions start. The pack for this project is in `packs/repo-security-scan/`.

## Available Agents & Skills

| Primitive | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `developer` agent | `.github/agents/developer.agent.md` | Implements a feature from a spec end-to-end |
| `feature-spec-generator` agent | `.github/agents/feature-spec-generator.agent.md` | Generates spec + user story files under `specs/` |
| `gh-cli` skill | `.github/skills/gh-cli/` | GitHub CLI operations |
| `copilot-sdk` skill | `.github/skills/copilot-sdk/` | Building with the `@github/copilot-sdk` |

## Project Layout Cheatsheet

```
src/              TypeScript source (NodeNext ESM)
packs/            APM packs installed into scanned repos
specs/            Feature specs generated by feature-spec-generator agent
workspaces/       Cloned repos (ephemeral, gitignored)
results/          Per-scan artifacts and summary (gitignored)
config.example.yml Reference config; copy to config.yml to get started
apm.yml           APM project manifest (agent primitives dependencies)
```
